title: Discrete-Time Signal Processing (3rd Edition)
authors: Alan V. Oppenheim, Ronald W. Schafer
annotation: Karya kanonikal pemrosesan sinyal digital waktu diskrit. Bab 4 menyajikan penurunan analitis mendalam teorema sampling Whittaker-Shannon dan analisis distorsi aliasing.

title: Digital Image Processing (4th Edition)
authors: Rafael C. Gonzalez, Richard E. Woods
annotation: Bab 2 membahas secara komprehensif sampling spasial dan kuantisasi intensitas citra digital, efek Moiré akibat aliasing 2D, serta pengaruh kedalaman bit terhadap kontras.

title: Communication Systems (5th Edition)
annotation: Bab 3 menguraikan formulasi matematis derau kuantisasi (quantization noise variance), penurunan rumus rasio SQNR 6.02b + 1.76 dB, dan modulasi pulsa kode (PCM).
